Administrative Action & Security Deployment: An overview of the restrictions placed around the Thirupparankundram hill area and the reports regarding central force (CRPF) deployment to maintain law and order.

Political & Social Impact: Suresh Kochattil examines the broader political implications in Tamil Nadu, addressing how different groups, religious organizations, and political leaders—including discussions surrounding CM Vijay—are responding to the situation.

Watch the full video for an in-depth perspective on the legal, administrative, and political dimensions of the Thirupparankundram issue.
